[[File:HolographicDarthMaul.jpg|thumb|Darth Maul's solid-state hologram.]]
A '''solid-state hologram''' was a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] that utilized a low level energy field to contain a high level of extremely dense photons, resulting in "solid light" that could have direct interaction with material objects.

[[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul]] was resuscitated as a solid-state hologram, and continued to exist as an apparition on [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]], terrorizing its inhabitants with sporadic appearances.
